# The Rundown

> The Rundown is the independent operations, CRM and RevOps consultancy of Jakub Krukowski, based in Szczecin, Poland, and working remotely in English and Polish. It works with teams of 5 to 500 people in any industry, usually after fast growth or a rough stretch left too many tools, unclear ownership and processes that live in a few people's heads. Typical clients are founders and operating directors who know they need a CRM or better information flow but not the best approach, and ops, sales or RevOps leaders who need an outside view or senior hands for a backlog or project.

## Services
- Process and ownership mapping: who does what, in what order, in which tool; each process documented on one page.
- CRM implementation and clean-up: HubSpot, Salesforce or Attio, set up or rebuilt around how the client sells and delivers, including data migration, de-duplication and pipeline design.
- Tool stack and tech debt clean-up: reviewing subscriptions and legacy systems to keep, replace, connect or switch off.
- Sales and RevOps: lead routing and follow-up, pipeline stages and reporting that sales and finance agree on, CRM admin and backlog work.
- Workflow automation: handoffs, reminders, reports and data entry automated with n8n, Tray.ai or Zapier.
- AI for repeatable tasks: drafting quotes from call notes, inbox triage, routine replies, weekly summaries, with a person approving what matters.
- Internal tools: quote calculators, dashboards and simple field apps when off-the-shelf software doesn't fit.
- AI and productivity training: hands-on sessions on a team's real tasks with Claude, Notion AI and existing tools.
- Adoption and change: the people who will use a new setup help design it, then short training on real work.
- Hiring a first operations person and building the operations function.

## Ways to work together
- Review and plan: a short review of how work flows today and a written plan with priorities and costs.
- Fixed-scope project, such as a CRM implementation or an automation build.
- Ongoing monthly help, as a fractional ops or RevOps lead or for backlog work.
- Workshops on AI and productivity for a team.

## Principles
- Independent: no software resale or vendor commissions.
- Accounts, automations and documentation are set up in the client's name.
- Work usually starts with a free 30-minute call, then a short review and a written plan with priorities and costs.
